user.title: Connect to ncSender
user.description: Enter the address of the machine running ncSender (the embedded server, port 8090 by default).

data_description.laser_max_s: Highest S value your laser accepts (e.g. 1000). Spindle commands above this are treated as the VFD spindle; at or below with no RPM feedback are treated as the laser.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach ncSender at that address. Check the host, port, and that ncSender is running.

data.output_pins: Aux output pins exposed as switches

data_description.laser_max_s: Highest S value your laser accepts. Spindle commands above this are treated as the VFD spindle.
data_description.telemetry_interval: How often positions, RPM, feed rate and progress are updated in Home Assistant. Lower is more responsive; higher keeps the recorder database smaller during long jobs. State changes (job status, spindle on/off, alarms) are always immediate.
data_description.output_pins: Comma-separated grblHAL aux output numbers (the N in M64 PN), e.g. "0, 2". Each becomes a switch that mirrors ncSender Auxiliary I/O state. Pins need no physical wiring: an unused number acts as a virtual switch you can mirror onto a Home Assistant device.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Send a raw G-code or realtime command to ncSender.

command.name: Command
command.description: Command text as typed in the ncSender terminal.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Only needed with multiple ncSender entries.
